confidence_notes: Food anchors rest on several Jeonju-specific aggregator estimates, some undated, so they are medium confidence. The cappuccino figure relies on chain prices and a single-city Wonju listing that I could not verify. The beer figure uses 2023 domestic draft prices and Seoul pub listings, and it excludes the draft-beer tax change proposed for 2027 because it falls after the July 2026 window. The cocktail is adjusted down from Seoul venue data. The wine glass is derived from the local beer relationship (about 1.8x draft beer) because I found no 2026 Jeonju wine-by-glass price. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate; I did not search accommodation or check live listings. The FX value of 0.6720 for 18 Nov 2026 comes from search summaries that attribute it to the RBA 4pm rate; I did not open the rba.gov.au page directly, and I found no 19 Nov figure. Verify the FX value before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food anchors use Jeonju-specific aggregated cost-of-living estimates. Drink anchors use Seoul venue data adjusted down for a smaller regional city, with beer as the reference for cocktail and wine. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for mid-sized Korean regional cities based on general knowledge, not on live booking data.
